_note: v2.3 plan 07 / L4 (R9 live, real model). The expansion of `generated-fork` is written by the REAL model (no debug response); the check requires a beat with two or more outcomes (positive activation; a `failed`/`stale` chain is regenerated the way the author's Regenerate button does, up to three real generations, every attempt reported; `needs_review` is accepted and reported, because such a chain is merged and played — there is no author accept path — so its routes must be playable too), then drives route 1 (outcome index 1 at the first forking beat, by declaration order) with author /cp-style quality writes, each a real boundary, and asserts that exactly that outcome's transition fired and the route reaches the `finish` anchor. Route selection is deterministic on purpose: the model's part is the chain; which route a player takes is the engine's, and this proves every route the model wrote is playable. Cadence 50 keeps real reads from writing the gate qualities.

steps.eval: for (const key of Object.keys(globalThis).filter((k) => k.startsWith('storyOrchestratorDebug'))) delete globalThis[key]; globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.setExtractionSettings({ enabled: true, cadence: 50 }); return true;

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const tries = []; let entry = null; const settle = async () => { const end = Date.now() + 480000; while (Date.now() < end) { const found = Object.values(rt.getSnapshot().expansion?.entries ?? {}).find((candidate) => candidate.stubId === 'fork_stub') ?? null; if (found && ['validated','inserted','needs_review','failed','stale'].includes(found.status)) return found; await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 2000)); } return null; }; for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= 3; attempt += 1) { entry = await settle(); if (!entry) throw new Error(`no settled expansion for fork_stub within 8 minutes: ${JSON.stringify(tries)}`); tries.push({ attempt, status: entry.status, outcomes: entry.beats.map((beat) => beat.outcomes.length), codeCheck: entry.codeCheck?.issues ?? null, verdicts: JSON.stringify(entry.verdicts ?? []).slice(0, 300) }); if (['validated','inserted','needs_review'].includes(entry.status)) break; if (attempt === 3) throw new Error(`three real generations and none merged: ${JSON.stringify(tries).slice(0, 2000)}`); if (!(await rt.expansions.regenerate(entry.key))) throw new Error(`regenerate refused for a ${entry.status} chain: ${JSON.stringify(tries)}`); } const forks = entry.beats.map((beat, index) => ({ index, outcomes: beat.outcomes.length })).filter((beat) => beat.outcomes >= 2); if (!forks.length) throw new Error(`positive activation not met: the merged chain has no beat with two outcomes: ${JSON.stringify(tries)}`); globalThis.__fork = { route: 1, forkBeat: forks[0].index, stubId: entry.stubId, status: entry.status, beats: entry.beats.map((beat) => ({ objective: beat.objective, outcomes: beat.outcomes.map((outcome) => ({ label: outcome.label, gate: outcome.gate, progress: outcome.progress ?? null })) })) }; return { status: entry.status, tries, forks, beats: globalThis.__fork.beats };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const fork = globalThis.__fork; const story = rt.loaded?.story; if (!story) throw new Error('no loaded story'); const quality = (key) => story.qualityByKey[key]; const other = (key, value) => { const q = quality(key); if (q.type === 'bool') return String(!value); const values = (q.values ?? []).filter((candidate) => candidate !== value); if (!values.length) throw new Error(`no other value for ${key}`); return String(values[0]); }; const leaves = (gate) => (gate.all ?? gate.any ?? null) ? (gate.all ?? [gate.any[0]]).flatMap(leaves) : [gate]; const satisfy = (leaf) => { if (/^progress_toward_/.test(leaf.q)) return null; const q = quality(leaf.q); if (!q) throw new Error(`gate names an unknown quality ${leaf.q}`); if (leaf.op === '==') return String(leaf.v); if (leaf.op === '!=') return other(leaf.q, leaf.v); if (leaf.op === '>=' || leaf.op === '<=') return String(leaf.v); if (leaf.op === '>') return String(Number(leaf.v) + 1); if (leaf.op === '<') return String(Number(leaf.v) - 1); if (leaf.op === 'in') return String(leaf.v[0]); throw new Error(`gate op ${leaf.op} not driven by this check`); }; const path = []; for (let step = 0; step < 16; step += 1) { const active = rt.getEngineState().activeCheckpointId; if (active === 'finish') break; const outgoing = story.transitions.filter((transition) => transition.from === active).sort((a, b) => b.priority - a.priority); if (!outgoing.length) throw new Error(`stuck at ${active}: no outgoing transition`); const atFork = active === `gen_${fork.stubId}_${fork.forkBeat + 1}`; const wanted = atFork ? outgoing[fork.route] : outgoing[0]; if (!wanted) throw new Error(`no route ${fork.route} out of ${active}`); for (const leaf of leaves(wanted.gate)) { const value = satisfy(leaf); if (value === null) continue; if (String(rt.getEngineState().blackboard.values[leaf.q]) === value) continue; await rt.setQuality(leaf.q, value); if (rt.getEngineState().activeCheckpointId !== active) break; } if (rt.getEngineState().activeCheckpointId === active) await rt.commitBoundary(); const log = rt.engine.stateLog ?? []; const fired = [...log].reverse().find((row) => row.fired)?.fired ?? null; path.push({ from: active, to: rt.getEngineState().activeCheckpointId, firedPriority: fired?.priority ?? null, atFork, wantedPriority: wanted.priority }); if (rt.getEngineState().activeCheckpointId === active) throw new Error(`the route did not move out of ${active}: ${JSON.stringify(path)}`); } const forkStep = path.find((row) => row.atFork); if (!forkStep) throw new Error(`the walk never passed the fork beat: ${JSON.stringify(path)}`); if (forkStep.firedPriority !== forkStep.wantedPriority) throw new Error(`route ${fork.route} was asked for at the fork but another outcome fired: ${JSON.stringify(forkStep)}`); if (rt.getEngineState().activeCheckpointId !== 'finish') throw new Error(`route ${fork.route} did not reach the anchor: ${JSON.stringify(path)}`); return { route: fork.route, path };
